decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already captures the accepted streamlined layout strategy and the required reduction in spacing; no additional update or removal is needed.
The one-page letter target is already represented by its same-message INTRODUCE Event and is distinct from the full-document page-limit compaction.
Reducing paragraph and section spacing does not change the required section order or permit section reordering.
The page-limit decision does not change the number, appendix placement, or integration method of the biographies.
The source does not remove or alter the requirement to incorporate the organization chart.
The client's conditional offer to trim awkward portions later is not a concrete decision to remove or alter required narrative content.
The spacing reduction does not change which proposal tables must be included or which replacements must be used.
The source does not alter the requirement to include a table of contents.
Paragraph and section spacing is a layout-compaction rule and does not change the established typeface or font-size consistency rules.
The page-limit modification does not change the Agua Arc brand identity, colors, or logo requirements.
Compacting the current RFQ response does not resume or modify the deferred reusable-template requirement.
The page-limit decision does not alter Canva delivery, editability, ownership, asset, or reuse terms.
